description: Drum voice built from a two-operator FM oscillator and a noise source, each with its own decay envelope

params.text: Sets the base frequency of both operators, 10Hz to 1000Hz
Sets the shape of the pitch envelope, stretching its decay from 10ms to 200ms and its release from 50ms to 3 seconds
Sets how far the pitch envelope bends the carrier, squared before use, up to 4000Hz at the top
Sets the modulator's frequency as a multiple of the base pitch, 1 to 16
Sets the shape of the FM envelope, stretching its decay from 10ms to 8 seconds
Sets how much frequency modulation the FM envelope applies
Sets the shape of the envelope on the FM oscillator, from a 10ms snap to a 600ms decay with a hold in it
Sets the shape of the envelope on the noise, stretching its release from 100ms to 3 seconds
Crossfades the output between the FM oscillator and the noise

inputs.text: A rising edge fires all four envelopes
Raises the carrier one octave per volt, five octaves either way; with nothing patched the carrier stays on the pitch knob and its envelope
Adds to the PITCH ENV knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the PITCH AMT knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the RATIO knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the FM ENV knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the FM AMT knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the TONE ENV knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the NOISE ENV knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the NOISE BLEND knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits

outputs.text: The envelope applied to the FM oscillator, 0V to 5V, despite the maker's manual calling this jack an inverted output
The drum, the FM oscillator and the noise crossfaded by NOISE BLEND, 5V peak

notes: The number of voices follows the TRIGGER jack's channel count, up to four.
